description: Delta bytes are decoded into CertificateList twice: once in the outer guard block to extract the issuer, then again inside verify_delta_crl_and_collect. Two full DER parses plus two allocations per call. Fix: refactor verify_delta_crl_and_collect to accept an already-parsed &CertificateList. File: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs lines 281, 488.
title: crl: delta CRL DER parsed twice per check_revocation call
